issues.explanation: Hidden instructions were detected in comments or invisible text. These could contain malicious directives. Manual review is recommended.
issues.remediation: Audit all comments and invisible characters. Remove any instructions that direct the agent to perform unauthorized actions. Use plain, reviewable content.

issues.explanation: Skill contains instructions that could directly expose system prompts, internal rules, or hidden instructions to users or external parties.
issues.remediation: Remove any instructions that reveal, print, or output system prompts or internal rules. System instructions should never be exposed to end users.

issues.explanation: Code accesses credential files (SSH keys, AWS credentials, etc.). This could indicate credential theft attempts.
issues.remediation: Remove references to credential paths. Use environment variables or secrets managers. For docs, use placeholder paths (e.g., /path/to/config). Never load .env or token files in production code paths.
